title: GdUnit4 addon triggers an out-of-bounds error on first export
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: `4.5.1.stable`, `4.6.3.stable`, `4.7.2.stable`.

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable (ed1daf0bf) - cpe:/o:nixos:nixos:26.11 26.11 (Zokor) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 550 / 550 Series (RADV POLARIS12) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700F (20 threads) - 15.45 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When the [GdUnit4](https://store.godotengine.org/asset/mikeschulze/gdunit4-unit-testing-framework) addon is installed, Godot will crash when the project is exported from the command line for the first time.

Subsequent exports will succeed (as long as the `.godot` directory is retained inbetween exports), but Godot will still print strange error messages.

This bug is particularly disruptive when you're exporting in a CI environment, because a fresh `.godot` directory have to be generated every time.

### Steps to reproduce

First, prepare the project and install the addon:

```bash
$ mkdir export-crash && cd export-crash
$ touch project.godot
$ curl -sSL https://store.godotengine.org/asset/mikeschulze/gdunit4-unit-testing-framework/download/4418 | bsdtar -xvf- --strip-components 1
```

Then, open the editor with `godot -e`, choose the <kbd><kbd><samp>Project</samp></kbd> ⇒ <kbd><samp>Export...</samp></kbd> ⇒ <kbd><samp>Add...</samp></kbd> ⇒ <kbd><samp>Linux</samp></kbd></kbd></kbd> menu option and quit the editor.

Finally, export the project:

```bash
$ godot -v --export-release Linux export-crash
```

Godot will crash with the following error message:

```bash
Pointer left window 0.
Script docs haven't been properly loaded or regenerated, so don't save them to disk.
EditorSettings: Save OK!
XR: Clearing primary interface
XR: Removed interface "Native mobile"
XR: Removed interface "OpenXR"

Freeing Default Tex_Blit Shader
MultiUmaBuffer 'RENDER_LIST_OPAQUE' used a total of 1 buffers. A large number may indicate a waste of VRAM and can be brought down by tweaking MAX_EXTRA_BUFFERS for this buffer.
MultiUmaBuffer 'RENDER_LIST_MOTION' used a total of 0 buffers. A large number may indicate a waste of VRAM and can be brought down by tweaking MAX_EXTRA_BUFFERS for this buffer.
MultiUmaBuffer 'RENDER_LIST_ALPHA' used a total of 1 buffers. A large number may indicate a waste of VRAM and can be brought down by tweaking MAX_EXTRA_BUFFERS for this buffer.

================================================================
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.7.2.stable.nixpkgs (ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079)
Dumping the backtrace.
Load address: 6335e9845000

ERROR: FATAL: Index p_index = 1 is out of bounds (size() = 0).
   at: get (./core/templates/cowdata.h:197)
```

Subsequent exports will succeed, but the following warnings will be logged:
